Title: Shared guest password lets anyone sign in as any listed email
Evidence: backend/main.py POST /api/auth/guest-login: one GUEST_LOGIN_PASSWORD + any email → session for that email's role (incl. observer); no per-person identity, no audit, no expiry.
Remediation: Removed guest-login. Individual guest access: request/invite → approval + whitelist → single-use 15-min magic link; 90-day access; audit log (core/guest_access.py, routers/exp_admin_guests.py). Delete GUEST_LOGIN_PASSWORD from the live Secret.
Status: Fixed in code — verify after deploy

Title: App served every route unauthenticated when no auth env was set
Evidence: backend/main.py require_* dependencies no-op'd unless Basic/Google/JWT env set; production relied on the ingress alone; any in-cluster client bypassed auth.
Remediation: Fail closed: 503 when nothing is configured; open mode only with EXP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_DEV=1 (local). Pinned by tests/unit/test_security_controls.py.
Status: Fixed in code — verify after deploy

Title: X-Dev-Email header could impersonate any user
Evidence: backend/main.py trusted X-Dev-Email whenever the Basic pair was configured.
Remediation: Honoured only with EXP_ALLOW_DEV_EMAIL_HEADER=1 (never set in k8s); default-off pinned by tests.
Status: Fixed in code — verify after deploy

Title: No admin boundary on roster replace and mentor-roster writes
Evidence: routers/exp_roster.py replace mode and routers/exp_mentor_roster.py uploads/PATCH were open to any authenticated user (documented open gap in CLAUDE.md).
Remediation: Replace mode is admin-only; mentor-roster writes need observer/admin (core/permissions.py); invalid class now 422 instead of writing NULL. Frontend hides/confirms.
Status: Fixed in code — verify after deploy

Title: Session token in redirect URL; 12-hour stateless token could not be revoked
Evidence: main.py OAuth callback redirected to /#token=<jwt>; core/auth.py SESSION_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = 12h, no server-side state.
Remediation: Callback returns a one-time 60-s #login_code exchanged by POST; 15-min access JWT bound to a server-side session (idle 60 min, absolute lifetime, rotating refresh token, logout/revoke immediate).
Status: Fixed in code — verify after deploy

Title: Google sign-in did not require a verified email

Remediation: .github/workflows/secret-scan.yml: every push to any branch + PR + weekly, fetch-depth 0, 8.30.1 + SHA-256, baseline, custom-rule self-test; .pre-commit-config.yaml (pre-commit framework).

Title: Pod hardening gaps: SA token mounted, no NetworkPolicy, writable root FS, client IP not seen

Remediation: automount off, readOnlyRootFilesystem + /tmp emptyDir, k8s/backend/networkpolicy.yaml, Dockerfile --proxy-headers trusted from RFC 1918 only. Needs kubectl apply (Patrick).
